_note: Config snapshot for exp-006 (issue #14 / ADR 0021): CPU-feasible precompute half of the pool sweep at size 2000 for all three construction strategies. Committed config files were not edited; the child scripts were invoked directly (not through scripts/pool_sweep_orchestrator.py) so that --device could be pinned to cpu instead of the orchestrator's forced pool_sweep.json 'device': 'cuda'. Every other value used is the committed default already present in the named config (verified equal to pool_sweep.json's own values). The decomposer/eval half of the sweep is not covered here; it is deferred behind exp-004/exp-005's hold on runs/run.lock.

pool_sweep_json_relevant_fields.device_override_rationale: pool_sweep_orchestrator.py's stage_similarity and stage_rerank pass --device unconditionally from this cfg key, and stage_sample_pool passes it for the clustered balance only -- confirmed live via 'pool_sweep_orchestrator.py --dry-run --only size2000_imbalanced,size2000_balanced,size2000_clustered', which printed --device cuda on every similarity/rerank command and on the clustered sample_pool command. Running any of those on cuda now would compete for the ~3 GiB of GPU headroom that exp-004/exp-005's waiter (runs/rearmed_wait_and_launch.sh) is watching for, which the brief for this run forbids. CPU is not an invented value: configs/similarity.json's own top-level 'device' key already defaults to cpu, and configs/musique_prep.json's sample_pool.clustering.device also already defaults to cpu -- this run reached those defaults by omitting --device (or passing it explicitly as cpu) when calling the child scripts directly, rather than through the orchestrator which overrides them.

commands_run: MusiQue/scripts/sample_pool.py --config musique_prep.json --size 2000 --balance clustered --seed 42 --out-dir runs/pool_sweep/pools/size2000_clustered_trial0_poolseed42 --embed-model e5-small --device cpu --similarity-config similarity.json

MusiQue/scripts/check_question_similarity.py --config similarity.json --query-file <dev_sample> --pool-file <pool.jsonl> --mode all --top-k 20 --n 750 --device cpu --embed-model e5-small --run-dir <sim_dir> --out <sim_dir>/top20.jsonl   (x3, one per balance)

MusiQue/scripts/rerank_similarity_results.py --config similarity.json --input <top20.jsonl> --out <ce_dir>/top5_ce.jsonl --cross-encoder cross-encoder/ms-marco-MiniLM-L-12-v2 --rerank-k 5 --device cpu --run-dir <ce_dir>   (x3, one per balance)

output_paths_match_orchestrator_helpers.verified_against: pool_sweep_orchestrator.py --dry-run --only size2000_imbalanced,size2000_balanced,size2000_clustered (printed paths compared byte-for-byte against this run's actual output paths)
